hook: The AI gave you a 7-step framework when you just needed a straight answer.
caption:
The AI gave you a 7-step framework when you just needed a straight answer.

You asked: "Should I take this job offer?"

It gave you: A balanced pros and cons list. Considerations about work-life balance. A reminder to "trust your gut." Three follow-up questions to reflect on.

Cool. Super helpful. You now know nothing you didn't know before.

Here's what was actually happening: the AI defaulted to "thorough" because it had no idea you're someone who already overthinks everything and needed someone to just call it.

It didn't know you process decisions by hearing a direct opinion first, then stress-testing it.

It didn't know that "here are all the angles" is your villain origin story.

This is the gap between a generic AI and one that actually knows how you think.

Same question. Different person. Completely different useful answer.

BootFile maps your thinking style once — so every response after that is built for how YOUR brain actually wants to receive information.

No more wading through seven paragraphs to find the one sentence you needed.
